name: tepora
description: Tepora V3 companion and asynchronous worker workspace

scripts.check: npm --prefix Tepora-v3 run check && node --check scripts/doctor.mjs && node --check scripts/release_notes.mjs && node --check scripts/check_commit_convention.mjs && node --check scripts/conventional_commits.mjs
scripts.test: npm --prefix Tepora-v3 test && npm run test:entry
scripts.quality: npm run check && npm --prefix Tepora-v3 run improve:check -- --capabilities && npm run test:entry
scripts.quality:full: npm run check && npm --prefix Tepora-v3 run improve:full && npm run test:entry
scripts.pretest: npm run build:core && npm run build:native
scripts.prequality: npm run build:core && npm run test:rust
scripts.prequality:full: npm run build:core && npm run test:rust
